records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased $27.8 million, or 2.4%, for the three months ended July 29, 2023 compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended July 29, 2023, net sales in our Europe, Australia, and Canada segments increased by 28.3%, 9.0%, and 5.9% compared to the prior year, while net sales in our United States segment decreased by 4.2% compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities during the six months ended July 30, 2022 was primarily due to a decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities related to overhead and inventory, as well as the impact of our net loss.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Improving margins through operational discipline and increased emphasis on higher margin collectibles and pre-owned product categories;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the six months ended July 29, 2023, cash flows from operating activities were an outflow of $211.8 million, compared with an outflow of $407.3 million during the same period last year.
